Start: ai-proxy [--restart] [--key=value | --key value ...]
  --restart  Gracefully replace the owned proxy instance, waiting for its exit.
  --version  Print the product version.
Stop:   ai-proxy stop [--data-directory <path>]
Status: ai-proxy status [--data-directory <path>] [-f text|json]  (exit 3 when nothing runs)
USAGE:
    ai-proxy [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

EXAMPLES:
    ai-proxy harness claude --model opus

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help    Prints help information

COMMANDS:
    gain                    Show estimated initial-request token reductions and 
                            history                                             
    replay                  Replay stored requests through the compression      
                            pipeline and show what it would save                
    doctor                  Check the setup without changing anything           
    status                  Show the running proxy instance (exit 3 when none   
                            runs)                                               
    stop                    Gracefully stop the running proxy instance          
    shortcut                Create or remove the aph shortcut for ai-proxy      
                            harness                                             
    mcp                     Run the retrieval MCP server over stdio             
    harness <EXECUTABLE>    Launch a harness executable through the running     
                            proxy

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Replay stored requests through the compression pipeline and show what it would 
save

USAGE:
    ai-proxy replay [OPTIONS]

OPTIONS:
                                     DEFAULT                                    
    -h, --help                                  Prints help information         
        --minimum <TOKENS>                      The smallest region, in         
                                                estimated tokens, that becomes a
                                                preview (default: the proxy's   
                                                own)                            
        --budget-share <SHARE>                  The share of a region's reduced 
                                                tokens a preview may hold, above
                                                0 and at most 1 (default: the   
                                                proxy's own)                    
        --minimum-saving <TOKENS>               The least a preview must save   
                                                over the reduced text, in       
                                                estimated tokens (default: the  
                                                proxy's own)                    
        --skip-under <TOKENS>                   A numbered read or a diff whose 
                                                reduced text is under this many 
                                                estimated tokens is not         
                                                previewed; 0 turns the skip off 
                                                (default: the proxy's own)      
        --since <DATE>                          Replay only requests from this  
                                                date or time on (UTC)           
        --source <SOURCE>            both       Where to read bodies: content,  
                                                capture, both                   
        --include-encoded              
[truncated]
